requirements.title: Catalog and navigation
acceptance: All 26 catalog entries retain IDs, player ranges, categories, rules and supported modes.
Category filtering, deduplicated recent games, per-game resume and deep links remain available.
Home stays home even with unfinished rounds; game deep links open the named game.
Back/Forward and keyboard navigation dispose the old game; stale lazy loads cannot mount.
Load failures are actionable errors rather than false Coming soon screens.
requirements.implementationScope: All 26 native entries retain IDs, routes, categories, player limits and artwork. Live recent/resume links follow coordinated storage updates across tabs, with native aliases, errors, keyboard navigation and desktop/mobile evidence. Full release qualification remains separate.

requirements.title: Shared game experience
acceptance: Collapsed setup shows a useful summary and immediate start; persist per-game choices.
Help offers rules, controls and goals; player names and auxiliary settings stay expandable.
Reset confirms intention; active actor, last outcome and next action stay visible above secondary content.
Distinctive original pieces/boards, inspectable objects, touch/keyboard controls and reduced-motion feedback.
Victory announces player/team; room guests celebrate their own wins.
requirements.implementationScope: Shared collapsed setup, help, options, reset confirmation and actor/result feedback cover all 26 native games. Memory display/checkpoint separation and private handoffs retain recovery behavior with coordinated saves. Browser accessibility, reduced motion and complete-game flows pass; physical-device release qualification remains open.

requirements.title: Persistence and recovery
acceptance: Preserve arcade-prefixed settings, names, scores, recent games and local checkpoints.
Use each game’s actual expiry from game-session.js; timed games retain absolute deadlines across hide/reload.
Validate checkpoints; finished/expired rounds never resurrect; preference/high-score data survives expiry.
Surface storage failures without blocking playable in-memory sessions.
requirements.implementationScope: All 26 native checkpoint/settings shapes retain the original keys and expiry/validation. Version 1 preserves raw legacy backups before mounting React, protects failed/future migrations and offers private exports. Web Locks coordinate competing checkpoint/score/recent writes, reject stale same-game replacement/deletion and refresh shelf/preferences across tabs. Complete-game and two-tab desktop/mobile flows pass; physical-device release qualification remains open.

requirements.title: Room admission and sharing
acceptance: Host creates unique per-guest invitations; guest returns answer accepted in original host tab.
Native share, clipboard fallback, local QR generation/scanning and raw-link fallback remain available.
Camera denial, QR overflow and connection failure explain the next action.
Connected guests default selected; host may spectate seats and sees games valid for selected count.
requirements.implementationScope: Native per-guest invitations, native share/clipboard/QR fallback, selected guest player/spectator seats, mid-match spectator admission and supported-game filtering. Protocol v9 and all eleven room games have desktop/mobile browser evidence; physical-camera and cross-network qualification remain release gates.
requirements.releaseGate: Physical camera scanning and cross-network (Wi-Fi/cellular) room qualification remain release gates; see release-qualification.md and device-validation.md.

requirements.title: Authority and private information
acceptance: Retain the eleven room-supported games and room-only Mafia behavior.
Host validates actor, seat, round and revision; guests submit intents and cannot set authoritative outcomes.
Private hands/roles/deck order stay on host; each recipient sees only its permitted view.
Room standings retain per-game/player wins, losses, draws and rankings across replays.
requirements.implementationScope: All eleven room games enforce host authority, player seats and revision/round checks, private player views and public-only spectator projections. Per-player/per-game wins, losses, draws and baseline rankings persist across replay, lobby and reconnect. Protocol v9 restores valid v1–v8 backups. Physical-device/cross-network release qualification remains open.
requirements.releaseGate: Cross-network room qualification and on-device private-view inspection remain release gates; see release-qualification.md and device-validation.md.

requirements.title: Room reconnection
acceptance: Transient disconnection pauses turns; same-seat invitation/answer recovery retains the round.
Host reload restores a tab-scoped checkpoint; guests exchange fresh links and receive only their own views.
Mismatched reconnect name cancels invitation without destroying seat or game.
Eliminated Business seats do not block resume; surviving selected seats must reconnect.
Disclose STUN/network need and absence of signaling/TURN; offline local play remains available.
requirements.implementationScope: All eleven room games have authoritative tab-scoped player/spectator recovery, fresh same-seat invitations and name validation. Spectators do not pause players; eliminated Business seats and Mafia absent-seat rules retain their behavior. Protocol v9 retains valid v1–v8 backups. Physical-device/cross-network qualification remains open.
requirements.releaseGate: Cross-network reconnection and physical two-device qualification remain release gates; see release-qualification.md and device-validation.md.

requirements.title: Sound, feel and themes
acceptance: Auto/light/dark theme, persistent sound/haptics settings, user-gesture audio unlock and recovery.
Impact-sensitive synthesized effects, distinct wins and optional haptics; reflect actual platform support.
No promise of audible output from API readiness alone; test controls explain iOS limitations.
High contrast, reduced motion and responsive original artwork across all game surfaces.
requirements.implementationScope: Persistent Auto/Light/Dark theme, shared sound/haptics controls, gesture unlock/recovery, per-game move/result/capture/dice/timer cues, Simon notes, recipient-specific room outcomes and action-game impacts. Reduced-motion CSS covers all 26 native game entry/play surfaces, with live race/2048 travel cancellation. Physical-device audible-output/haptics qualification remains open.
requirements.releaseGate: Physical audible-output and haptics qualification remain release gates; see release-qualification.md and device-validation.md.

requirements.title: Offline assets and data pipeline
acceptance: Cache shell, all game modules, icons, QR worker and approved movie content for local offline play.
Retain Telugu movie sources/credits, top three actors and synopsis in appropriate revealed contexts.
No movie details leak through hidden Imposter handoffs.
Preserve developer-only ingestion/annotation/export tools and keep credentials/raw development data outside deployment.
Keep attribution for original and third-party art/code.
requirements.implementationScope: Verified production asset graph, scoped workers/updates, raw backups, private exports and competing-tab saves have desktop/mobile evidence. The developer pipeline defaults to the local OpenAI-compatible API with three parallel validated candidates, generous retries, repeated quality rounds and a 5/10 confidence gate rechecked through promotion/publication. Live three-candidate approval at 9/10 and fresh desktop/mobile export inspection pass; physical-device release qualification remains open.
requirements.releaseGate: Physical install/standalone and cross-network offline qualification remain release gates; see release-qualification.md and device-validation.md.

requirements.title: Spelling Bee
acceptance: Make words using seven letters and the required center letter. Hunt pangrams solo or build a shared score in a cooperative room.

Make words of at least four letters using only the seven hive letters. Every word must include the golden center letter. Letters may repeat. Four-letter words score 1; longer words score their length. A pangram uses all seven letters and adds 7 points. The bundled practice dictionary is finite. Reach Genius at 70% of available points, then find every accepted word for Queen Bee. Room players share the hive, found words and team score; duplicate submissions do not score twice.

requirements.title: Letter Boxed
acceptance: Chain words around a twelve-letter square without consecutive letters from the same side. Cover every letter solo or cooperatively.

Use at least three letters per word. Consecutive letters must come from different sides of the square. Your next word must start with the last letter of the previous word. Letters may be reused, but words may not repeat. Cover all twelve letters to win; try for two words. The bundled dictionary is finite. Undo removes the last word. Private-room players cooperate on one shared chain.

requirements.title: Mini Crossword
acceptance: Solve an original five-by-five crossword with Across and Down clues. Share a grid locally or in a cooperative private room.

Fill the 5×5 grid using the Across and Down clues. Tap a clue to select its row or column; tap a cell again to switch direction. Type letters and use arrow keys to move. Check letters highlights incorrect entries without changing them. Reveal letter fills the selected cell and records assistance. Rooms share entries and revealed letters; the host accepts edits in revision order. These original Mini puzzles use word-square grids, so Across and Down answers intersect symmetrically.

requirements.title: Tiles
acceptance: Match layered visual patterns, chain a remaining tile for combos, and clear the tray solo or in a turn-based cooperative room.

Select two different tiles sharing a ring, shape or background pattern. All matching layers disappear from both tiles. A tile clears when all three layers are gone. Reuse a remaining tile from your previous match to grow the combo; switching to a new pair starts a new combo. Clear every layer to win. Local multiplayer and private rooms take turns after each accepted match and share a team score. Invalid matches do not consume a turn.
